set_default_hook_class: set the default hook class used by the SPDL pipeline for event handling
get_default_hook_class: get the currently configured default hook class for the SPDL pipeline
set_default_queue_class: set the default queue class used by the SPDL pipeline for data buffering
get_default_queue_class: get the currently configured default queue class for the SPDL pipeline
is_diagnostic_mode_enabled: check whether diagnostic mode is currently enabled in the SPDL pipeline
